description: Look things up in the shared, read-only knowledge base. Start with op read and no path (the root); the root tells you what exists. Then read the child you need; find searches by keyword. Errors: NodeMissing (the line lists what exists), PathBad, MemoryMissing (no knowledge base is set up for you: say so).

op.description: read = show a node's text and its children; ls = list its children only; find = search nodes by keyword

path.description: node path like agents/spawn (lowercase segments joined by /); empty or / is the root; read also accepts node#/JSON/Pointer (RFC6901 ~0/~1 escapes), only on .json leaves; ls/find reject #

max_bytes.description: read: most bytes of node text to show (default 8000)
